newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita jumps over 6 pct as selling eases.
newsitem.headline: Merita jumps over 6 pct as selling eases.

text.p: Shares in Finnish banking group Merita Oy rose to a three-month high in heavy trade on Tuesday as foreign selling pressure eased, brokers said.
At 1350/1050 GMT, Merita traded at three-month high 10.60 markka, up 0.63 markka or 6.32 percent. Turnover was massive for Merita at over 32 million markka.
Brokers said the stock started rising after a London operator had finally sold a large chunck of Merita shares. This reduced immediate supply.

"One London house has been selling (Merita) for some time now and this has capped any gains in the share price," one broker said. "Now that one big seller is out, the share is free to rise," he added.
Brokers saw scope for more gains ahead.
"At this rate, we will be testing new levels for a while," one said.
